component: QuickLoot IE (Ensrick rebuild for Skyrim SE 1.7.104)
mo2ModNameNote: The folder name says 1.7.99 while the runtime is 1.7.104. The DLL is version-independent (Address Library), so the name is cosmetic.
purpose: Native QuickLoot IE build that loads on the 1.7.104 runtime, from the Ensrick fork with the theft/owner-policy fixes.
license: MIT. QLIE-LICENSE.md ships inside the package; FORK_NOTES.md: 'The project remains available under the MIT License. The original copyright and permission notice are preserved in LICENSE and must accompany redistributed copies'. (#160 originally said GPL; corrected.)
